title: Spider Vibes
description: Spider Vibes automates the Pathfinder 2e Remaster Recall Knowledge action per GM Core's actual rules: rarity-adjusted DC by level, correct skill-by-trait table, a Lore-skill discount, secret rolling so the player never learns their own degree of success, and an escalating-DC repeat-check chain that locks out after a failure. On success the player picks number-free information pulled from the creature's own sheet, compiled into a persistent Codex journal with a documented API other tools can build on.
